declaration.preface:
Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. is committed to integrating sustainability into its procurement and supply chain management practices by promoting responsible sourcing, ethical business conduct, environmental stewardship, and social responsibility throughout its value chain. As a leading manufacturer of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, API pellets, and specialty chemical products, the Company recognizes that its suppliers and business partners play a critical role in supporting operational excellence, product quality, regulatory compliance, and long-term sustainable growth.

The Company believes that procurement decisions should extend beyond considerations of quality, cost, and delivery to include environmental, social, ethical, and governance (ESG) performance. By working collaboratively with suppliers, contractors, service providers, distributors, and other business partners, Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. seeks to minimize environmental impacts, uphold human rights, promote fair labor practices, strengthen responsible governance, and build a resilient and sustainable supply chain.
declaration.declaration: Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. is committed to conducting procurement activities in a responsible, transparent, ethical, and sustainable manner. The Company recognizes that procurement decisions significantly influence environmental performance, social responsibility, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term business sustainability. Accordingly, sustainability considerations shall be integrated into procurement strategies, supplier selection processes, commercial decision-making, contract management, and supplier performance evaluation.
declaration.scope:
This Value Chain Integrity Policy applies to all procurement activities, sourcing decisions, supplier relationships, contracting processes, and supply chain operations conducted by Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. across all manufacturing facilities, research and development centres, warehouses, laboratories, utilities, and corporate offices under its operational control.

This Policy is applicable to:

All procurement, sourcing, purchasing, contract management, logistics, inventory management, finance, quality assurance, manufacturing, engineering, EHS, and other business functions involved in procurement decisions.

All permanent, temporary, contractual, probationary, trainee, apprentice, and part-time employees participating in procurement and supplier management activities.

All suppliers, vendors, contractors, consultants, distributors, transport providers, service providers, third-party manufacturers, and business partners supplying goods or services to the Company.

All procurement categories, including raw materials, chemicals, packaging materials, engineering items, utilities, capital equipment, maintenance services, logistics, information technology, facility management, and professional services.

All supplier qualification, selection, onboarding, contracting, performance evaluation, supplier development, supplier audits, and procurement governance activities undertaken by the Company.

Guiding Principles: Responsible Sourcing: Integrate environmental, social, ethical, quality, safety, and governance considerations into procurement decisions while balancing cost, quality, reliability, and sustainability.

Legal and Regulatory Compliance: Ensure procurement activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, environmental requirements, labor standards, and ethical business practices.
Supplier Partnership and Collaboration: Foster long-term relationships with suppliers based on transparency, mutual trust, shared responsibility, continuous engagement, and collaborative improvement.

Environmental Stewardship: Encourage suppliers to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve resource efficiency, conserve water, minimize waste generation, prevent pollution, and protect biodiversity throughout their operations.

Respect for Human Rights and Fair Labor Practices: Promote responsible labor practices by encouraging suppliers to prohibit child labor, forced labor, discrimination, harassment, and unsafe working conditions while respecting internationally recognized human rights.

Ethical Procurement and Business Integrity: Conduct procurement activities fairly, transparently, and objectively while preventing fraud, bribery, corruption, conflicts of interest, and other unethical business practices.

Supplier ESG Risk Management: Identify, assess, prioritize, and manage environmental, social, ethical, operational, and governance risks associated with suppliers and procurement activities through appropriate due diligence processes.

Transparency and Accountability: Promote accurate documentation, responsible reporting, objective supplier evaluations, and accountability across procurement processes while maintaining fairness and consistency in decision-making.
Supplier Environmental Practices: We are committed to partnering with suppliers who demonstrate responsible environmental management by complying with applicable environmental laws, regulations, permits, and recognized industry standards while continually improving their environmental performance.

We encourage suppliers to implement effective environmental management systems that promote efficient use of energy, water, raw materials, natural resources, and other critical inputs while reducing greenhouse gas emissions and environmental impacts across their operations.

We expect suppliers to manage waste responsibly by minimizing waste generation, promoting reuse and recycling, ensuring environmentally sound disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste, and adopting circular economy principles wherever practicable.

We will periodically assess supplier environmental performance through sustainability questionnaires, supplier evaluations, audits, performance reviews, and collaborative engagement programs to encourage continual environmental improvement across the supply chain.
Supplier Social and Labor Practices: We are committed to sourcing goods and services from suppliers who respect internationally recognized human rights, provide safe and healthy working conditions, and maintain responsible labor practices throughout their operations.

We expect suppliers to prohibit child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, human trafficking, discrimination, harassment, and any form of workplace exploitation while ensuring compliance with applicable labour laws and international labour standards.

We encourage suppliers to provide fair wages, lawful working hours, statutory benefits, freedom of association, equal employment opportunities, and respectful working conditions that promote employee dignity and well-being.
We encourage suppliers to promote diversity, equity, inclusion, employee development, and continuous learning while fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace culture.

We will monitor supplier social and labor performance through supplier assessments, audits, corrective action plans, and ongoing engagement to strengthen responsible employment practices throughout the value chain.
Sustainable Procurement Goals: We are committed to integrating environmental, social, ethical, quality, safety, and governance considerations into supplier selection, qualification, contracting, and procurement decision-making processes to promote responsible sourcing across all procurement categories.

We will establish sustainability-based supplier evaluation criteria that consider environmental compliance, labor practices, ethical conduct, regulatory performance, operational capability, product quality, and business continuity while selecting and retaining suppliers.

We encourage procurement of products, materials, equipment, and services that are resource-efficient, environmentally preferable, recyclable, reusable, responsibly sourced, and aligned with applicable sustainability objectives wherever feasible.

We will strengthen supplier capability through awareness programs, sustainability communication, technical engagement, capacity-building initiatives, and collaborative improvement projects that enhance supplier ESG performance.

We encourage responsible local procurement and supplier diversity, where appropriate, to strengthen regional economic development, improve supply chain resilience, and reduce transportation-related environmental impacts.

We will periodically review procurement strategies, supplier sustainability performance, and sourcing practices to identify opportunities for innovation, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and continual improvement.
Governance Goals: We are committed to conducting procurement activities with integrity, fairness, transparency, and accountability while ensuring compliance with applicable laws, Company policies, and responsible business conduct principles.

We expect suppliers, contractors, consultants, and business partners to comply with the Company's Supplier Code of Conduct, sustainability requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable environmental, labor, ethical, and governance standards.

We will implement risk-based supplier due diligence processes to identify, assess, and manage environmental, social, ethical, operational, financial, and regulatory risks associated with procurement activities and supplier relationships.

We will establish structured supplier performance monitoring mechanisms through periodic assessments, audits, scorecards, management reviews, and corrective action plans to encourage continual supplier improvement.

We encourage suppliers to promptly address identified non-conformities and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions within agreed timelines while maintaining open communication with the Company.

We will periodically review procurement governance frameworks, supplier risk management processes, performance indicators, and sustainability objectives to strengthen responsible procurement practices and support continual improvement across the supply chain.

policy.monitoring: Vasudha Pharma Chem Ltd. shall regularly monitor the implementation and effectiveness of this Value Chain Integrity Policy through defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), supplier ESG assessments, supplier audits, procurement reviews, supplier scorecards, due diligence processes, risk assessments, and management reviews. Performance against the Company's sustainable procurement objectives and quantitative targets shall be periodically evaluated to identify opportunities for improvement, strengthen supplier engagement, and enhance supply chain sustainability.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Value Chain Integrity Policy shall be reviewed at least once every two years, or earlier if required due to changes in applicable legal or regulatory requirements, business operations, procurement strategies, stakeholder expectations, supplier risks, or internationally recognized sustainability standards. Any revisions shall be approved by the appropriate management authority before implementation.

The Procurement & Supply Chain Head, in coordination with the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Compliance, and Management, shall be responsible for initiating the review process, evaluating the effectiveness of this Policy, and recommending necessary updates to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with the Company's sustainability objectives, procurement strategy, and responsible sourcing commitments.
